content.text:
Brightloop has three plans (prices in euros, excluding VAT):

| Plan | Price | Users | Highlights |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | €0 | up to 3 | Unlimited projects, 1 GB storage, board and list views |
| **Team** | €8 per user/month | up to 50 | Timeline view, guest access, 100 GB storage |
| **Business** | €15 per user/month | unlimited | SSO (SAML), audit log, 1 TB storage, priority support |

Some billing details:
- Yearly billing saves 20% on Team and Business.
- Paid plans include a 14-day free trial, and no card is needed to start it.
- Guests are free and don't use a seat.
- Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at the end of the billing period.

Source: Brightloop documentation, "Pricing and plans" (https://brightloop.example/docs/pricing)

Your data is stored in the European Union. The primary data centre is in Frankfurt, and the backup is in Amsterdam. Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Databases are backed up daily and kept for 35 days.

Brightloop also signs a GDPR data processing agreement (DPA) with every paying customer on request, and an independent ISO/IEC 27001 audit takes place every year.

Source: Brightloop documentation, "Security and privacy" (https://brightloop.example/docs/security)

content: Thanks, which plan would you recommend for a team of 12?

content.text:
For 12 people, I'd recommend the **Team** plan, unless you need SSO, the audit log, or priority support, which are only on Business.

- **Team:** 12 × €8 = **€96 per month**, or about €77 per month if you pay yearly (20% off)
- **Business:** 12 × €15 = **€180 per month**

Prices exclude VAT. Guests don't take a seat, so they don't add to the cost.

Source: Brightloop documentation, "Pricing and plans" (https://brightloop.example/docs/pricing)
